'''Waypoint Station Aurek''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] military station built on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It served as a secure base for soldiers and medical personnel during the reconstruction of Taris. Later, the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] conquered the base and established the '''tower command station''' there.

==Personnel==
Commander [[Viqui]] led Waypoint Station Aurek, commanding the various Republic scouts, riflemen and officers. Captain [[Childress]] was head of security for the base. Doctor [[Ianna Cel]] was also based at Aurek, along with her team of medical personnel, as well as [[Cera (Human)|Cera]] and [[Garthe]].
